method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999, Compilation No. 96, compilation date 1 January 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 72, 2025 (Register id C2026C00081), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00446.txt; the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Regulations 2019, which set the higher registration turnover threshold under s 23-15(1)(b), are not deposited, so that amount is an input (the cases assume $75,000, and $150,000 for a non-profit body); the formulas in ss 9-75(1), 11-30(3), 17-5(1) from ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00446.formulas.md (transcribed by hand 21 October 2026 from the Word rendering of volume 1 of the same compilation)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the sole trader or business owner (the entity that carries on the enterprise): s 9-20 (enterprise, worked out from facts), s 23-15 (threshold: $50,000 / $100,000 non-profit, or the higher amount the regulations specify, an input), ss 188-10, 188-15, 188-20, 188-25, 188-30 (current and projected GST turnover; the Commissioner's satisfaction that projected turnover is below is an input), ss 23-5, 23-10, 144-5 and s 195-1 'taxi travel' (must I register, may I register; taxi travel requires registration regardless of turnover), s 25-1 (apply within 21 days; also as a regulative rule), s 9-5 (taxable supply), ss 9-40, 9-70, 9-75 (10% of value; value = price x 10/11, reconstructed from the section's example as the deposit drops the formula), ss 11-5, 11-15, 11-20, 11-25, 11-30 (creditable acquisitions; input tax credit; partly creditable formula reconstructed), ss 29-10(3), 29-80 (tax invoice needed above $50 value), s 29-70(2) (tax invoice within 28 days of request), ss 7-5, 17-5 (net amount = GST - credits), ss 31-5, 31-8, 31-10, 33-3 (returns and payment due dates). Not encoded: Divisions 38/40 beyond a fact (GST-free or input taxed part), Chapter 4 special rules, importations, adjustments, cash accounting, s 25-10 date of effect and cancellation, monthly-period elections and determinations, machinery.
seat: the sole trader or business owner (the entity that carries on the enterprise, asking 'Must I register for GST?')
